integrity_statement: Two complete finite checkers with different mechanisms reproduce the lower-bound census; the argument includes a transfer recurrence and explicit finite witnesses. No external independent mathematical audit or formal proof-assistant certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact total-bondage values are proved only for P_5 square P_4, P_7 square P_4, P_8 square P_4, with the isolate-free edge-deletion convention. No extrapolation to other lengths, and no count of all four-edge cuts, is asserted. Search cannot rule out unpublished equivalent calculations.
title: Sharp initial total-bondage thresholds in four-column grid graphs
